newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yip's Pota ends debut 90 percent higher.
newsitem.headline: Yip's Pota ends debut 90 percent higher.

text.p: Shares of souvenir manufacturer Yip's Pota International Co Ltd closed their debut trading on Monday at HK$1.90 per share, up 90 cents from their issue price of HK$1.00.
Profit-taking set in to trim gains after active speculative buying pushed prices to a day high of HK$2.425, one broker said.
A total of 93.79 million shares worth HK$166.38 million changed hands.
Brokers said small local investors trying to benefit from the rising market were snapping up shares of medium- and small-sized companies.

Yip's Pota offered 50 million shares in an initial public offering, raising net proceeds of about HK$40 million to fund the purchase of a manufacturing plant and machinery, repay bank borrowings and for working capital.
The company is a manufacturer of promotional items made of PVC leather.
